questions.question: Dr Ramdan receives a rent revision notice of 30% without valid reason. According to Article 5, how should he react?
options: Accept the revision to avoid a conflict
Challenge it by invoking Law No. 07-03 on rent revision
Pay under protest while waiting for the court
Immediately vacate the premises
questions.explanation: Art. 5, para. 3: the revision of the rent is subject to the provisions of Law No. 07-03. An abusive revision must be challenged.

questions.question: Dr Kamali installed a luminous sign without the landlord's permission. According to Article 8, can this behavior cause him to lose his right to eviction compensation?
options: Yes, because it constitutes a transformation of the premises
No, the sign is considered necessary equipment
Yes, but only if it exceeds 5 m²
No, the landlord must first authorize it
questions.explanation: Art. 8, 2°: the landlord is exempt from compensation if the tenant transforms the premises, unless he restores the premises within a period not exceeding 3 months.

questions.question: Dr Ramdan's landlord wishes to sell the building during the lease. According to Law 49-16, what are the seller's obligations?
options: Terminate the lease before the sale
Inform the tenant and respect his right of pre-emption
Increase the rent to make the sale more attractive
Nothing, the lease is not enforceable against the new owner
questions.explanation: The tenant benefits from a right of pre-emption. The seller must inform him and respect this right.

questions.question: Dr Kamali had his practice appraised and estimates the value of his business at 1,200,000 DH. According to Article 7, on what basis will the eviction compensation be calculated?
options: On the value estimated by the expert
On the tax declarations of the last 4 financial years
On the sale price of dental equipment
On the annual turnover
questions.explanation: Art. 7, para. 3: the compensation is calculated on the basis of the tax declarations for the last four financial years.

questions.question: Dr Ramdan's landlord attempts to evict him for personal recovery. According to Article 26, what is the applicable deadline?
options: 15 days
1 month
3 months
6 months
questions.explanation: Art. 26, para. 2: the period is set at 3 months when the request is based on a desire to repossess the premises for personal use.

questions.question: Dr Kamali wishes to challenge a clause in his lease that he considers abusive. According to Article 6, what is the scope of such a clause?
options: It is valid because the parties are free to contract
It is null if it contravenes the provisions of the law
It is valid for the first 5 years
It is subject to the approval of the commercial court
questions.explanation: Art. 6: any stipulation contrary to the provisions of the law is null. The law is a matter of public policy.

questions.question: Dr Ramdan's landlord complains about noise nuisances coming from his practice. According to Article 26, how should this type of dispute be qualified?
options: A serious reason relating to non-compliance with the lease clauses
A simple nuisance without legal consequence
A case of force majeure
A reason for early termination of the lease
questions.explanation: Art. 26, para. 2: noise nuisances constitute a serious reason relating to non-compliance with the lease clauses (deadline of 3 months).

questions.question: Dr Kamali took possession of the premises without a joint inventory. According to Article 3, what are the consequences?
options: None, the inventory is not mandatory
It will be impossible to prove the initial condition of the premises
The lease is automatically null
The landlord may increase the rent by 20%
questions.explanation: Art. 3, para. 2: when handing over the premises, a descriptive inventory must be drawn up to serve as evidence between the parties.

questions.question: Dr Ramdan wishes to challenge an increase in rental charges. According to Article 5, what must he prove?
options: That the charges are not provided for in the lease
That the charges are excessive compared to the market
That the landlord does not provide supporting documents
All of the above answers are correct
questions.explanation: Art. 5: the tenant may challenge charges if they are not provided for, if they are excessive, or if the landlord does not provide supporting documents.

questions.question: Dr Kamali receives a formal notice to pay unpaid rent for 4 months. According to Article 33, what does he risk?
options: Termination of the lease after unsuccessful formal notice
An automatic rent increase
A flat-rate fine of 10,000 DH
A prohibition from practicing in the premises
questions.explanation: Art. 33: the lessor may take action in default of payment of rent for a period of three months, after formal notice remaining unsuccessful for 15 days.

questions.question: Dr Ramdan's landlord must carry out repair works. According to Law 49-16, who bears the cost of these works?
options: The tenant alone
The landlord alone
The tenant and the landlord equally
The landlord, unless the lease provides otherwise
questions.explanation: Repair works generally fall to the landlord. However, the lease may provide for different provisions.

questions.question: Dr Kamali wishes to give notice to his landlord before the end of the lease. According to Article 26, what are his obligations?
options: Respect a 3-month notice period
Respect a 6-month notice period
Respect the contractual provisions of the lease
The law does not provide for a notice period for the tenant
questions.explanation: The conditions for the tenant's notice are generally provided for in the lease contract. The law does not impose a specific notice period.

questions.question: Dr Ramdan discovers that his premises have asbestos problems. According to Law 49-16, what is the landlord's responsibility?
options: None, asbestos is not regulated in commercial leases
The landlord must carry out asbestos removal works
The tenant must bear these works alone
The works are shared between the parties
questions.explanation: The landlord is required to deliver premises that comply with safety standards. Asbestos removal falls under his responsibility.

questions.question: Dr Kamali sublet part of his practice without the landlord's consent. According to Article 24, what are the consequences?
options: The sublease is valid because it is authorized by default
The landlord may request termination of the lease
The sublease is null and the subtenant must leave
The landlord can only increase the rent
questions.explanation: Art. 24, para. 1: subletting is authorized unless otherwise stipulated. In the absence of agreement, if the lease prohibits subletting, the landlord may take action.

questions.question: Dr Ramdan's landlord wishes to increase the rent under an indexation clause. According to Article 5, what is the legal limit of this increase?
options: No limit, the parties are free
The increase is capped by Law No. 07-03
The increase is limited to 5% per year
The increase is limited to the construction cost index
questions.explanation: Art. 5, para. 3: the revision of the rent is subject to the provisions of Law No. 07-03, which sets the rules for indexation and capping.

questions.question: Dr Kamali received a court summons for eviction. According to Article 28, what is the deadline to deposit the eviction compensation?
options: 1 month after the judgment
2 months after the judgment
3 months after the judgment becomes enforceable
6 months after the judgment
questions.explanation: Art. 28: the lessor is required to deposit the amount of compensation within a period of three months from the date on which the judgment becomes enforceable.

questions.question: Dr Ramdan's landlord asks him to carry out routine maintenance works. According to Law 49-16, who should carry them out?
options: The landlord alone
The tenant alone
Both equally
The tenant, unless the works are structural
questions.explanation: Routine maintenance works generally fall to the tenant, while structural works fall to the landlord.

questions.question: Dr Kamali wishes to challenge a clause in his lease that prohibits him from carrying out another activity in the premises. According to Law 49-16, is this clause valid?
options: Yes, the parties may restrict the activity
No, it is contrary to freedom of enterprise
Yes, if it is limited in time
No, if it is not justified by the purpose of the lease
questions.explanation: The lease may legitimately restrict the activity carried out in the premises to preserve the intended use of the premises.

questions.question: Dr Ramdan's landlord wishes to change the building's opening hours. According to Law 49-16, must the tenant accept?
options: Yes, the landlord has a police power
No, if it changes the practice's operating conditions
Yes, if the change is justified by security reasons
No, the landlord cannot impose hours
questions.explanation: Any change that substantially affects the operation of the practice requires the tenant's consent.

questions.question: Dr Kamali has changed his specialty and wishes to modify the activity of his practice. According to Law 49-16, what is the procedure?
options: He can do it without authorization
He must obtain the landlord's authorization
He must simply inform the landlord
He must wait for the renewal of the lease
questions.explanation: Any change in the intended use of the premises requires the landlord's consent, unless the lease allows it.

questions.question: Dr Ramdan is having difficulty paying his rent due to the crisis. According to Article 33, what deadline does he have to regularize?
options: 15 days after formal notice
30 days after formal notice
45 days after formal notice
2 months after formal notice
questions.explanation: Art. 33: the tenant has 15 days after formal notice to regularize his situation.

questions.question: Dr Kamali's landlord refuses renewal without reason. According to Article 6, what is the position of the law?
options: The refusal is valid if the landlord wishes
The refusal is abusive because the right to renewal is protected
The refusal is valid after 9 years of lease
The refusal is subject to the court's assessment
questions.explanation: Art. 6: any stipulation contrary to the right to renewal is null. Refusal without reason is abusive.

questions.question: Dr Ramdan wishes to carry out extension works. According to Article 8, what procedure must be followed?
options: The works are free as long as they do not affect the structure
He must obtain the written consent of the landlord
He can carry out the works and inform afterwards
The works are prohibited
questions.explanation: Art. 8: any transformation of the premises requires the landlord's consent, under penalty of losing the right to compensation.

questions.question: Dr Kamali signed a 3-year renewable lease. According to Article 4, under what condition is renewal acquired?
options: It is automatic after 3 years
It is acquired after 2 years of occupation
It is subject to the landlord's consent
It is impossible for 3-year leases
questions.explanation: Art. 4: the tenant benefits from renewal after 2 years of consecutive occupation.

questions.question: Dr Ramdan finally reached an agreement with his landlord. According to Law 49-16, how should this agreement be formalized?
options: By a simple handshake
By a written amendment to the lease contract
By an exchange of registered letters
By a declaration to the prefecture
questions.explanation: Any amending agreement to the lease must be formalized by a written amendment to be valid and enforceable.
